title: Create vs Edit
subtitle: New entity and edit entity with the same form UI
description: Share field components between create and edit by swapping key, initialData, and save.
content: Most apps reuse one form for create and edit. Only the resource config differs.

sections.title: Create config
sections.content: No fetch. Save returns the created entity (with server id).

sections.title: Edit config
sections.content: Fetch by id. Persist draft so refresh mid-edit is safe.

sections.title: After create: navigate or remount
sections.content: When create returns an id, either navigate to the edit route (new key) or call destroy and rebuild with edit config. Do not keep key `['contact','new']` after the entity exists — persist drafts would collide.
